sentences.text:
This appeal is filed by the Union of India under Section 54(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 ['L.A. Act' for short] challenging the judgment and award passed by NC: 2024:KHC-K:2114-DB the Reference Court in LAC No.5/2011, dated 03.09.2019 whereby, the compensation is enhanced to Rs.6,00,000/- from Rs.35,840/- per acre.
2.

The State of Karnataka has acquired the land bearing Survey No.60/A, measuring 02 acres 12 guntas, situated at Hosur Village, Raichur District, along with other lands for the purpose of laying Railway track by Notification dated 03.03.2005 under L.A. Act.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer has passed an award fixing the market value at Rs.35,840/- per acre with consequential benefits.
Being aggrieved by the same, the land loser sought for reference under Section 18 of the L.A. Act.
The Reference Court by the impugned judgment and decree has enhanced the compensation from Rs.35,840/- to Rs.6,00,000/- per acre.
Being aggrieved by the same, appeals had been filed before this Court in MFA No.200777/2015 and connected matters.

This Court by order dated 15.10.2020 has allowed the appeals, remanded the matter back to the Reference Court for fresh consideration.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:2114-DB 3.
In view of the order dated 15.10.2020 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in MFA No.200777/2015 and connected matters, this appeal is allowed.

The matter is remitted back to the II Additional Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Raichur, to reconsider LAC No.5/2011 in terms of the order dated 15.10.2020 passed by this Court in MFA No.200777/2015 and connected matters, after giving an opportunity to both the parties.
